steps.title: Draw the peak
steps.instruction: Begin at the very top with a ball. A band slopes down to the left, and four short lines cut it into tiles.

steps.title: Draw the roof
steps.instruction: The roof slopes down from the ball and runs to a round tip. Add its top, two wall lines and a long band.

steps.title: Draw the side wall
steps.instruction: Below the band, the corner runs down, along the ground and up to the roof's tip. Two windows, each on a ledge.

steps.title: Draw the chimney
steps.instruction: Next, the chimney: a short side up from the roof, a flat cap, and a second side below. Two pots stand on top.

steps.title: Draw the roof lines
steps.instruction: Close the roof from the chimney to the tip. Three wavy lines slope down it, and one runs along the bottom.

steps.title: Draw the top tiles
steps.instruction: Four bumps make the top row of tiles. Each one bridges two wavy lines.

steps.title: Draw the middle tiles
steps.instruction: Then four more bumps, one row lower.

steps.title: Draw the flower box
steps.instruction: On the front wall, a long flower box. Two bumpy bushes grow in it, with a short line between them.

steps.title: Draw the arched window
steps.instruction: Behind the bushes, an arched window: a big arch, a smaller one inside, and a cross of two bars.

steps.title: Draw the awning
steps.instruction: The awning hangs from the long band: two sides, a fold line and a wavy hem of seven bumps.

steps.title: Draw the stripes
steps.instruction: Six slanting lines divide the awning into seven stripes, right down to the hem.

steps.title: Draw the shop window
steps.instruction: Under the awning, the shop's left side and a post. Then the big window, with a cross of two bars.

steps.title: Draw the door
steps.instruction: Right of the window, the door: its frame, a tall pane of glass and a square panel. A line along the ground.

steps.title: Draw the table
steps.instruction: Out front, a small round table: a flat oval top on one leg that spreads into a foot.

steps.title: Draw the chairs
steps.instruction: A chair on each side: a rounded back and an oval seat. A line joins the two backs, under the window.

steps.title: Draw the left legs
steps.instruction: The left chair stands on three thin legs. Two short dashes between them show the shop's foot.

steps.title: Draw the right legs
steps.instruction: Three legs for the right chair too, and two more dashes of ground.

steps.title: Color the walls
steps.instruction: Cream for the walls, the chimney, the frames and ledges, three stripes and the tabletop.

steps.title: Color the roof
steps.instruction: Red for the roof, the pots and four stripes. Blue for every pane of glass.

steps.title: Color the shop
steps.instruction: Dark green for the shop front, green for the bushes. Orange for the chairs, the table leg and the flower box.
